component.name: Multron Download Manager
component.summary: Fast download manager for files, videos and torrents

description.p: Multron Download Manager downloads direct links, videos, cloud-drive files and torrents in one app.

Every file is split across 8 connections by default (1 to 64, changeable while the download runs). Connections that finish early take over the slowest parts, stalled connections are reopened, and downloads continue after a pause, a crash or a network change.

Videos and music from YouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok, Reddit, Twitch, SoundCloud and more than 1,800 other sites can be downloaded in every quality up to 12K, as MP4, MKV, WebM or MOV, or as audio only in MP3, FLAC, WAV and other formats. The size of every quality is shown before the download starts.

ul.li: A built-in BitTorrent client with magnet links, file selection, RSS feeds and seeding rules
Direct downloads from Google Drive, MEGA, Dropbox, MediaFire and Pixeldrain links
A browser extension that takes over browser downloads and adds a download button to videos
LinkGrabber, which finds every file on a web page and groups the links into packages
Automatic extraction of ZIP, 7z and RAR archives, with a password list
A scheduler, a download queue, per-site speed limits and rename and move rules
Privacy options, including downloads through Tor
SHA-256 verification, digital signature checks, VirusTotal and an optional cloud malware scan
Download statistics, a download history and automatic backups
Light and dark themes with adjustable colors and animations, in 12 languages

A torrent with its sources and peers

description.p: No CPU use while the window is idle or in the tray, less memory in the tray and looping effects off by default. The browser extension now catches video and audio streams from the page, and its video download button stays on the video instead of covering menus and pop-ups.

The first full release. LinkGrabber finds every file on a page, archives are extracted by themselves, and downloads can be scheduled, limited per site and sent through Tor. Also new: RSS feed search with built-in feeds, VirusTotal, statistics, a download history, automatic backups and a refreshed interface with adjustable colors and animations.
Every video quality up to 12K with its size, more audio and video formats, faster YouTube downloads and a video download button that can be moved.
Faster downloads when a server or a connection slows down, full-speed YouTube downloads and steady video progress.
